summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 21, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary Valour Inc. launched Valour Funds SPC, a new actively managed digital asset business line, and introduced Smart Crypto Fund SP, its first hedge fund, managed with Neuronomics AG's proprietary AI strategy under a Cayman Islands CIMA-registered vehicle. No stake, price per share, premium, consideration, expected close, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine product-launch/current report, not a special situation. Watch for follow-on capital-raising, fee, or AUM disclosures rather than deal terms.
